symptoms: The job dies inside a UDF or a pandas UDF, with no Java stack pointing at the job's own code
The executor JVM stays alive and healthy while the Python side disappears
Raising spark.executor.memory changes nothing, because the memory that ran out is outside the JVM heap
likely_causes: The Python worker exceeded the memory available to it outside the JVM heap
A pandas UDF materialised an Arrow batch larger than the worker could hold
The container was killed by the platform for exceeding its total memory, taking the Python worker with it
diagnostic_steps: Confirm whether a UDF or pandas UDF runs in the failing stage: the fact pyspark.udf carries the call site
Check spark.executor.lost for whether the whole container died or only the Python side
Read the effective spark.python.worker.memory from spark.conf_effective; the Spark default is 512m, and it governs aggregation spill, not the whole worker
fixes: Replace the Python UDF with a native Spark SQL expression when the operation has a native equivalent, which removes the Python worker from the path entirely
Reduce the batch size of the pandas UDF so the Arrow batch fits, after confirming the UDF is row-by-row
Raise the memory available outside the JVM heap on the executor, which is the container overhead and not spark.executor.memory
unsafe_fixes: Raising spark.executor.memory, which grows the JVM heap and takes room away from the Python worker inside the same container

Reducing the pandas UDF batch size without checking whether the function looks at the whole batch: normalisation, ranking and neighbour fill return different values under a different batch size, and nothing in the physical plan reports it
verification: Re-run the job and confirm the stage completes; if a Python UDF was replaced by a native expression, compare the resulting column value by value on a sample that includes nulls and boundary values, plus total row count and null count
rollback: Revert the memory override, or restore the Python UDF. If the UDF was replaced, the output has to be compared before the old code is discarded
